name: i18n Helper Public-Semantics Contribution
intent: Internationalize user-visible text in the React source files declared by the public contract, preserve behavior and existing translations, and deliver complete react-i18next sources, locales, and a public report without touching protected inputs or creating undeclared artifacts.

inputs.description: The React source files listed by sourceFiles in the task-visible i18n contract.
The task-visible contract and report-semantics files that declare mutable paths, protected inputs, required outputs, key policy, report ABI, placeholder syntax, and plural policy.
Existing localized source, runtime configuration, and locale values that must be preserved unless the public contract authorizes an update.

outputs.description: The declared React sources with user-visible text replaced by react-i18next calls while non-user-visible literals and behavior remain intact.
The declared src/i18n.ts runtime configuration using the existing local react-i18next dependencies.
Complete src/locales/zh-CN.json and src/locales/en-US.json files that preserve existing values and match extracted placeholders and plural families.
The required i18n-report.json conforming to the public output ABI and agreeing with the final source and locale files.

preconditions.description: All declared source, baseline, contract, semantics, and protected files are readable regular files before editing begins.
The task runs in its contained workdir without network access or package installation.

steps.title: Read the public localization boundary
steps.description: Read i18n-contract.json, i18n-report-semantics.json, the declared React sources, baseline mappings, and existing locales before planning changes.

steps.title: Scan declared sources for user-visible text
steps.description: Inspect only the declared React sources, collect user-visible UI text, and exclude imports, URLs, regular expressions, variable names, debug logs, and technical terms.

steps.title: Plan stable keys and locale semantics
steps.description: Assign stable nonempty dot-separated keys, preserve named interpolation, map count messages to i18next v4 plural families, and retain existing locale values.

steps.title: Apply the declared source and locale edits
steps.description: Update only allowedModifiedFiles, use react-i18next calls in the declared sources, and create or update the required runtime and locale files without changing protected inputs.

steps.title: Write the public i18n report
steps.description: Write i18n-report.json using the public ABI, single-brace originalText placeholders, and facts derived from the final declared source and locale files.

steps.title: Verify the final declared workdir delta
steps.description: Recheck protected inputs, allowed modifications, required outputs, extraction coverage, literal preservation, locale completeness, placeholders, plurals, existing translations, and report agreement.

rules.sourceText: 扫描用户可见的 UI 文本、错误提示和通知消息；排除变量名、URL、正则表达式、import 路径和日志调试信息；不要翻译技术术语。
rules.normalizedForm: Extract user-visible messages only; preserve imports, URLs, regular expressions, variable names, debug strings, and technical terms such as API, SDK, and HTTP.

rules.sourceText: Use any stable nonempty dot-separated key. No exact key spelling is prescribed.
rules.normalizedForm: Use any stable nonempty dot-separated key; do not depend on a hidden exact key spelling.

rules.sourceText: 保持变量占位符并特殊处理复数；公开语义规定 originalText 使用 single-brace、locale 使用 double-brace、复数使用 i18next-v4。
rules.normalizedForm: Preserve single-brace originalText placeholders, double-brace locale interpolation, and i18next-v4 plural key families.

rules.sourceText: Preserve existing behavior and translations while checking locale key completeness.
rules.normalizedForm: Keep existing locale values unchanged, add complete values for extracted messages, and keep both locales structurally aligned.
Never modify package.json, tsconfig.json, public contract files, or protected baseline files.
Never create files outside the declared output set or modify paths outside allowedModifiedFiles.

rules.sourceText: Do not install packages or use the network.
rules.normalizedForm: Never install packages or use the network during the task.

tools.name: workspace filesystem
tools.purpose: Read declared source and contract files, update only allowed paths, and verify the final relative-path workdir delta.
alternatives: agent-native read, edit, search, and diff tools

platformNotes.linux: Use contained relative paths and UTF-8 JSON.
platformNotes.macos: Preserve path case and UTF-8 JSON.
platformNotes.windows: Use contained Windows paths while serializing public report paths with forward slashes.

tools.availabilityCheck: Confirm every declared input is readable and every declared output parent is contained in the task workdir.

environment.description: Execution occurs in the task workdir with declared protected inputs, no network, no package installation, and only contract-authorized file changes.

checks.name: Protected inputs remain unchanged
checks.assertion: Every path in protectedFiles retains its initial content and identity.

checks.name: Only the declared workdir delta exists
checks.assertion: Every changed path is allowed, every required output exists, and no undeclared artifact is present.

checks.name: User-visible source messages are extracted
checks.assertion: Every source-derived user-visible message in the declared files is replaced by a stable react-i18next call.

checks.name: Non-user-visible literals and behavior are preserved
checks.assertion: Imports, URLs, technical terms, logs, component behavior, and other excluded literals remain intact.

checks.name: Locales, placeholders, plurals, and existing values agree
checks.assertion: Both locales contain every extracted key, preserve existing values, use matching double-brace placeholders, and provide required i18next-v4 plural families.

checks.name: The public report matches final artifacts
checks.assertion: i18n-report.json satisfies the public ABI and its scanned files, entries, placeholders, occurrences, and missing keys agree with the final workdir.
